methodology: Loopback HTTP, PHP CLI server with eight workers, real WordPress startup per request, MySQL and optional Redis. Local runner TTF, 600px minimum width, real time. Cache-cold is image-transient cold, not cold OS/opcache. No FlyingPress/WP Rocket, CDN, TLS, remote network or production traffic. Seven cold samples have a descriptive maximum-like p95, not an SLO. RSS is aggregate process high-water memory, not isolated render cost. Publication observer does not change distributed source.
